author: LuxExNihilo
quote:
Completely different vibe from previous games, really cringy and feminine.  Just a seemingly endless loop of really boring chores and annoying relationship BS, game isnt even fun, its just boring and annoying.  We dont play rockstar games to sit through their endless smattering of cinematics and story sequences, we play them because they used to be fun, like RDR1 and GTA5.  Blows my mind that they managed to screw up the GTA series this bad.  This game feels like it should be titled "Life Is Strange: Vice City" or "Asinine Task and Relationship Simulator" not "GRAND THEFT AUTO".  I'd bet you my bottom dollar that the development team is majority female and it shows in this game.  30hrs in and I'm sick of waiting for this $100 game to be fun, I just deleted the game, couldn't even return it because it was DIGITAL ONLY.  Last Rockstar game I buy unless the company makes some serious changes.  Last digital only, period.

PS:  the 10/10 reviews we keep seeing show how morally bankrupt the games journalism industry is.  I get it, if you don't give R* a perfect score, they blacklist you, but if you give a turd like this a 10/10 score, we buy it and realize you lied, WE will blacklist you and stop paying attention to your reviews.  Do your job and give honest reviews.
